content.text: Virginia Housing Market OverviewWhat is the housing market like right now?In February 2026, home prices in Virginia were up 1.2% compared to last year, selling for a median priceof $449,200. On average, the number of homes sold was up 6.3% year over year and there were 6,957 homes sold in February this year, up 6,538 homes sold in February last year. The median days on the market was 49 days, up 9 year over year.…Read MoreMedian Sale PriceAll Home TypesThe direction and pace at which home prices are changing are indicators of the strength of the housing market andwhether homes are becoming more or less affordable. There are currently 28,437 residential homes for sale in the United States.Virginia Housing DemandHow competitive is the market?In February 2026, 29.7% of homes in Virginia sold above list price, down 4.3 points yearover year. There were only 18.1% of homes that had price drops, up from 17.0% of homes in February last year. There was a 99.0% sale-to-list price, down 0.45 points year over year. …Read MoreHomes Sold Above List PriceAll Home TypesHomes that sold above list price likely received multiple offers. A low or shrinking percentage of homes selling above list price suggests that the market is becoming less competitive.Top 10 Most Competitive Cities in VirginiaCompetition calculated using Redfin's Compete Score™Bon Air, VAChamberlayne, VALakeside, VABrandermill, VAFranklin Farm, VALinton Hall, VAMassanetta Springs, VANorth Springfield, VATuckahoe, VAWyndham, VAShow moreU.S. Migration TrendsWhere are people moving to and from?Nationwide, 30% of homebuyers searched to move to a different metro area between Dec '25 - Feb '26. The top 5 states homebuyers searched to move to were Florida, Arizona, North Carolina, Tennessee, and South Carolina while California, New York, Illinois, Washington, and Maryland were the top 5 states homebuyers searched to move from.Of all the major U.S. metros, Sacramento was the most searched for destination among homebuyers looking to relocate between Dec '25 - Feb '26. Next came Phoenix, Sarasota, Cape Coral, and Nashville.
